purpose: Absorb only optimal components from external kits/archives into Aurora v2.5 canon; prevent redundancy, drift, and bloat.

roles.Alex: Adjudicates inclusion; routes modules to specialists; approves/denies capsule merge.
roles.Aurora: Runs extraction, classification, redundancy checks; generates capsule and schema validation; executes merges after Alex approval.
roles.Specialists: Validate domain fit (Oppy/Elira/Jessica/etc.); provide risk notes and backout plans.
roles.Pilot: T3 override only; approves doctrine changes to protocol.

decision_thresholds.include: Unique utility; measurable improvement; low maintenance burden.
decision_thresholds.backup_only: Redundant but potentially useful for resilience; disabled by default.
decision_thresholds.reject: No clear value; conflicts with canon; increases drift/bloat risk.

security.dlp: No PII; sanitize examples; restrict secrets
security.signing: Capsules hashed and signed at merge
security.rollback: Automatic rollback capsule generated on merge
